text.title: Our Holiday in Scotland
lines: Last summer, my family went on holiday to Scotland.
We stayed in a hotel next to an old castle.
On Tuesday it rained, so we visited a museum about dinosaurs.
On the last day, we had dinner in a restaurant by the sea.

questions.q: Why did they visit a museum?
